description: EEG sleep staging with compact spectral/time-domain features, per-night unsupervised normalization, multinomial logistic regression, and HMM-style temporal decoding. For each night we: (1) detrend each epoch by mean, (2) extract vectorized features: time-domain (std, peak-to-peak, mean absolute value, line length, zero-crossing rate, Hjorth mobility/complexity, skewness, kurtosis), frequency-domain via rFFT with Hamming window (relative bandpowers in delta/theta/alpha/sigma/beta for 0.5–30 Hz, three log band ratios, spectral centroid, spectral entropy, SEF90), and time-of-night features (index, sin, cos). Features are z-scored per night (unsupervised adaptation). We train a multinomial LogisticRegression (class_weight='balanced') on all labeled epochs (ignoring -1). A 5x5 Markov transition matrix and initial distribution are estimated from labeled training sequences with Laplace smoothing and diagonal self-bias. Test emissions are classifier probabilities mapped into 5 classes (missing classes get tiny mass). We decode each test night offline with Viterbi, then apply a light de-islanding pass to replace 1-epoch flips. Nights are processed independently, preserving boundaries. Deterministic seeds, single-thread classifiers, and no external assets.
